purpose: Describe football-side downside and fragility already implied by the pregame projection/distribution stack without changing that stack.

distribution_downside.definition: Exact football-only probability of finishing below a stat-specific downside threshold derived from that same pregame distribution.

relative_uncertainty.definition: Coefficient of variation from the combined weekly football uncertainty, capped for scoring stability.

projection_error_share.definition: Share of total modeled variance attributable to historical projection error rather than performance variance.

role_baseline_fragility.definition: Penalty for dependence on weaker baseline sources rather than player-specific historical evidence.

context_fragility.definition: Missing/non-current core football context plus current injury uncertainty flags; descriptive only because mean/SD adjustments are already applied upstream.

hard_block_rules: sportsbook price, implied probability, spread, total, or player prop enters the risk score
risk score changes a player projection mean or uncertainty
risk score changes a football probability
risk score changes EV or betting actionability
a missing/non-current context item is treated as observed zero risk
notes: Step 4 is downstream of Step 3B and consumes exact football-side distribution tails.
Injury and role effects already applied upstream are not re-applied to mean or SD; Step 4 only exposes fragility for interpretation.
The layer remains SHADOW_ONLY until live weekly inputs exist and downstream validation is intentionally enabled.
